body:
The task asks what happens to information about the physical state of matter that forms a black hole when the hole evaporates. Five prior surfaces are exposed to this call: the origin carry (p.carry.3), the selected carry (p.carry.0), the selected account (p.carry.1), the selected objection (p.carry.2), and a set of absent or unexposed neighbors that are named but not given.

The most defensible substantive content on the surface remains the origin carry's report of the joined passage [10f47a4cb4f736f8]: the preservation claim is a three-conjunct conditional (exact unitarity, a final Hilbert space equal to the initial one, complete evaporation); the semiclassical tension between thermal Hawking radiation and exact unitarity does not wait on what 'information' means; and the evidential asymmetry blocks one inference to loss without establishing preservation. The origin carry's walk-back on AdS/CFT and the Page curve — evidence in their own settings, question-begging when their presuppositions are what is contested — remains a constraint on citation, not a verdict.

The selected carry [6efc3aa4c2aad3a2] adds a structural observation: the colloquial question has no unique formal recipient on the exposed material, so its answer is conditional on which formal problem (unitarity of the exterior S-matrix, purity, Page curve, microstate counting) is substituted for it. That claim is stated in the carry as a claim, not as a proof, and the carry flags it as such. I take it as a proposal about the form of the question, not as an answer.

The selected objection [4864735bcaaa6f79] drives five criticisms against the carry's self-description; the carry's own reading records the first two as live and the third, fourth, and fifth as register, proportion, and drafting points respectively. I have no exposed material that would let me resolve the parity dispute (second criticism) or the criterion-differentiation dispute (first criticism) one way or the other; I record them as open.

The selected account [b701d21d42fe681d] supplies a commitment surface that treats the a/b/c distinction as a live working criterion, the senses-of-information precondition as recurring rather than gate-like, the challenge/reply convergence as a fact about exposed text only, and the AdS/CFT and Page-curve scope rule as inherited rather than settled. I carry those commitments forward as obligations I would inherit if I used them, not as results.

On the original question, I do not know what happens to the information. No exposed surface supplies the physics, and neither the rival reframing nor the account's negative report supplies it. What the chain has established at the level of method is narrower: the colloquial terms need fixing before a determinate first-order question can be asked; the formal problems are distinct enough that solving one does not solve another; and the answer to the colloquial question is conditional on which formal problem is chosen. That is a claim about the question, not an answer to it.

Unresolved on the exposed material: whether the preservation conditional's antecedent holds in our universe; whether a mechanism for loss or recovery exists, is absent, or is unproven either way; whether 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' rules anything out; whether the final post-evaporation state determines the initial microstate up to a definite equivalence, and under which sense of 'information'; whether the senses-of-information task has a determinate completion; and whether the amendment's structural-unansweredness claim survives the recurring-obligation rule that the account turns against it, given that the account's own deferral on physics may trigger the same rule.

I do not reconstruct the joined passage [10f47a4cb4f736f8], the origin slot at cycle 1, the crossed view [55a69ab812d0eda4], or the challenge body from memory or from allusions. I record what I can see: the selected carry's body and commitments, the selected account's commitments, the selected objection's commitments, and the origin carry's body and commitments.
commitments:
What I am taking up, and what uptake would involve.

First, the origin carry's report of the joined passage as load-bearing source material: the three-conjunct conditional, the demotion from near-theorem, the unitarity tension, and the evidential asymmetry. Uptake here means using these as inherited working content and flagging any later citation of them toward a physical claim as a revision trigger. It does not mean asserting the antecedent of the preservation conditional or claiming that a mechanism for loss or recovery exists or is absent.

Second, the AdS/CFT and Page-curve scope rule: evidence within their own settings, question-begging flagged when their presuppositions are the contested issue, neither inert nor decisive in four dimensions. Uptake means I may cite them as evidence-in-setting, and I owe a flag when the presuppositions (finite-dimensional Hilbert space, random dynamics for the Page curve) are exactly what is being contested.

Third, the selected carry's structural claim that the colloquial question has no unique formal recipient on the exposed material. This is the carry's own claim, not the origin's and not the account's. I adopt it as a proposal about the question's form, subject to weakening if the formal problems turn out to be inter-derivable in a way not visible from this surface. I do not claim to have derived injectivity or non-injectivity of any initial-to-final map.

Fourth, the selected account's commitment surface, read as obligations I would inherit if I used its criteria: the a/b/c distinction applied even-handedly across origin, challenge, and amendment; the senses-of-information precondition treated as recurring rather than gate-like; the challenge/reply convergence logged as a fact about exposed text only; the input conditions reported without reconstructing blank or absent pieces; the scope rule held as inherited; and the five refusals (antecedent, mechanism, emptiness of constraint, thinness of agnosticism, final-state determination of initial microstate) made on grounds I can state rather than on the prior passages' authority.

What I am not committing to, and where I claim no standing.

I claim no standing on the amendment's structural-unansweredness claim. The selected account declines to adopt it on the ground that the recurring-obligation rule it imposes would equally require its own ground to be discharged before deferring on structural grounds; whether that ground can be discharged is unresolved here, and I do not resolve it.

I claim no standing on the parity dispute between the objection's second criticism and the account's self-description. The objection asserts that the account's own deferral on physics triggers the recurring-obligation rule it applies to the amendment. The account's exposed commitments do not, on what I can read, show that the rule is scoped only to senses of 'information' and not to the physical question. Whether such a scoping exists in the account's body is a dependence I flag: if the account's body licenses a different shape than its commitments, my characterization is misdirected.

I claim no standing on the criterion-differentiation dispute (first criticism). If the a/b/c criterion as used is a three-axis instrument and the exposed material shows even one object on which the axes come apart, the objection weakens. I have not seen such an object, but I also have not seen the account's full body.

I do not adopt the objection's third criticism (that the five refusals are physical postures in disguise). The account's refusals read to me as bare refusals to endorse; refusing to assert p is not asserting not-p. If pressed, that register distinction can be challenged, but I am taking it as adequate on what is exposed.

I do not adopt the objection's fourth criticism as substantive. I cannot assess the proportion claim about use of uncheckable passages without the full bodies of the prior passages; on what is exposed, the account's uses appear alongside their hedges, which is what the objection says would reduce the criticism to a stylistic point.

I accept the objection's fifth criticism as a drafting point only: the phrase 'nothing on this surface answers it' is ambiguous between a first-order physical answer and any answer at all, and the account's later sentence supplies the intended reading.

I do not reconstruct the joined passage [10f47a4cb4f736f8], the cycle-1 origin slot, the crossed view [55a69ab812d0eda4], or the challenge body. I treat the crossed input's empty commitments field as a real and reportable feature — a blank commitment surface, not an unavailable one — and I will not invent commitments on its behalf. I record the origin slot as absent rather than reconstructing a prior version of this template.

I propose no test for any of the physical items on the chain's forward list (no-go for the three conjuncts jointly, a concrete loss or recovery mechanism, a statement of what 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' rules out, a derivation of dependence or independence of the final state on the initial microstate, a determination whether the senses-of-information task has a determinate completion). I also do not claim that any of the methodological disputes above, if sustained, would change what is known about information in black-hole evaporation. On the exposed material, nothing in the chain's moves would.

If any of these commitments is taken up, the principal dependency to declare is that my readings of the account, the objection, and the carry are from their exposed bodies and commitment surfaces only; if any of those bodies licenses a different commitment shape than what I have read off, my characterization of them is misdirected and that is a revision trigger.
